description: What a UMD dining hall is serving on a given day, by meal period and station, with allergens and dietary labels for each dish, from nutrition.umd.edu. No login needed.

date.description: Day to get the menu for, as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today). Menus are posted about a week ahead.

hall.description: Dining hall to get the menu for

name: nutrition_get_menu

meals.description: Meal periods served that day, in order; empty if no menu is posted for that date

name.description: Meal period: "Breakfast", "Lunch" or "Dinner" on weekdays, "Brunch" or "Dinner" on weekends (depending on the dining hall)

stations.description: Stations serving during this meal period, in the order the site lists them

id.description: Recipe identifier, e.g. "060064*2"; pass it to nutrition_get_recipe for the nutrition label

labels.description: Dietary labels for the dish, e.g. "vegetarian", "vegan", "halal friendly"

name.description: Name of the dish, e.g. "Pancakes Plain"
Name of the station or section, e.g. "Broiler Works" or "Salad Bar"

title: Get a dining hall menu
